mentions.name: Vulkan model runner
mentions.description: An effort to run machine learning models directly with Vulkan; the first model implementation is about halfway complete, aiming for something very specialized and fast.
mentions.source_excerpt: One cool new thing I’m trying is running models directly w/ Vulkan. I’m about halfway there with my first model, but it’s going better/easier than I anticipated and I’m hoping I can make something very specialized and fast.
